en.text: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

zhSimplified.text: 酒能使人亵慢，浓酒使人喧嚷； 凡因酒错误的，就无智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 酒能使人褻慢，濃酒使人喧嚷； 凡因酒錯誤的，就無智慧。

en.text: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

zhSimplified.text: 王的威吓如同狮子吼叫； 惹动他怒的，是自害己命。

zhTraditional.text: 王的威嚇如同獅子吼叫； 惹動他怒的，是自害己命。

en.text: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

zhSimplified.text: 远离纷争是人的尊荣； 愚妄人都爱争闹。

zhTraditional.text: 遠離紛爭是人的尊榮； 愚妄人都愛爭鬧。

en.text: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

zhSimplified.text: 懒惰人因冬寒不肯耕种， 到收割的时候，他必讨饭而无所得。

zhTraditional.text: 懶惰人因冬寒不肯耕種， 到收割的時候，他必討飯而無所得。

en.text: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

zhSimplified.text: 人心怀藏谋略，好像深水， 惟明哲人才能汲引出来。

zhTraditional.text: 人心懷藏謀略，好像深水， 惟明哲人才能汲引出來。

en.text: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

zhSimplified.text: 人多述说自己的仁慈， 但忠信人谁能遇着呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人多述說自己的仁慈， 但忠信人誰能遇着呢？

en.text: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

zhSimplified.text: 行为纯正的义人， 他的子孙是有福的！

zhTraditional.text: 行為純正的義人， 他的子孫是有福的！

en.text: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

zhSimplified.text: 王坐在审判的位上， 以眼目驱散诸恶。

zhTraditional.text: 王坐在審判的位上， 以眼目驅散諸惡。

en.text: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

zhSimplified.text: 谁能说，我洁净了我的心， 我脱净了我的罪？

zhTraditional.text: 誰能說，我潔淨了我的心， 我脫淨了我的罪？

en.text: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 两样的法码，两样的升斗， 都为耶和华所憎恶。

zhTraditional.text: 兩樣的法碼，兩樣的升斗， 都為耶和華所憎惡。

en.text: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

zhSimplified.text: 孩童的动作是清洁，是正直， 都显明他的本性。

zhTraditional.text: 孩童的動作是清潔，是正直， 都顯明他的本性。

en.text: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.

zhSimplified.text: 能听的耳，能看的眼， 都是耶和华所造的。

zhTraditional.text: 能聽的耳，能看的眼， 都是耶和華所造的。

en.text: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

zhSimplified.text: 不要贪睡，免致贫穷； 眼要睁开，你就吃饱。

zhTraditional.text: 不要貪睡，免致貧窮； 眼要睜開，你就吃飽。

en.text: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

zhSimplified.text: 买物的说：不好，不好； 及至买去，他便自夸。

zhTraditional.text: 買物的說：不好，不好； 及至買去，他便自誇。

en.text: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

zhSimplified.text: 有金子和许多珍珠， 惟有知识的嘴乃为贵重的珍宝。

zhTraditional.text: 有金子和許多珍珠， 惟有知識的嘴乃為貴重的珍寶。

en.text: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

zhSimplified.text: 谁为生人作保，就拿谁的衣服； 谁为外人作保，谁就要承当。

zhTraditional.text: 誰為生人作保，就拿誰的衣服； 誰為外人作保，誰就要承當。

en.text: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

zhSimplified.text: 以虚谎而得的食物，人觉甘甜； 但后来，他的口必充满尘沙。

zhTraditional.text: 以虛謊而得的食物，人覺甘甜； 但後來，他的口必充滿塵沙。

en.text: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

zhSimplified.text: 计谋都凭筹算立定； 打仗要凭智谋。

zhTraditional.text: 計謀都憑籌算立定； 打仗要憑智謀。

en.text: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

zhSimplified.text: 往来传舌的，泄漏密事； 大张嘴的，不可与他结交。

zhTraditional.text: 往來傳舌的，洩漏密事； 大張嘴的，不可與他結交。

en.text: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

zhSimplified.text: 咒骂父母的，他的灯必灭， 变为漆黑的黑暗。

zhTraditional.text: 咒罵父母的，他的燈必滅， 變為漆黑的黑暗。

en.text: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

zhSimplified.text: 起初速得的产业， 终久却不为福。

zhTraditional.text: 起初速得的產業， 終久卻不為福。

en.text: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.

zhSimplified.text: 你不要说，我要以恶报恶； 要等候耶和华，他必拯救你。

zhTraditional.text: 你不要說，我要以惡報惡； 要等候耶和華，他必拯救你。

en.text: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

zhSimplified.text: 两样的法码为耶和华所憎恶； 诡诈的天平也为不善。

zhTraditional.text: 兩樣的法碼為耶和華所憎惡； 詭詐的天平也為不善。

en.text: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?

zhSimplified.text: 人的脚步为耶和华所定； 人岂能明白自己的路呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人的腳步為耶和華所定； 人豈能明白自己的路呢？

en.text: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

zhSimplified.text: 人冒失说，这是圣物， 许愿之后才查问，就是自陷网罗。

zhTraditional.text: 人冒失說，這是聖物， 許願之後才查問，就是自陷網羅。

en.text: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧的王簸散恶人， 用碌碡滚轧他们。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧的王簸散惡人， 用碌碡滾軋他們。

en.text: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

zhSimplified.text: 人的灵是耶和华的灯， 鉴察人的心腹。

zhTraditional.text: 人的靈是耶和華的燈， 鑒察人的心腹。

en.text: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

zhSimplified.text: 王因仁慈和诚实得以保全他的国位， 也因仁慈立稳。

zhTraditional.text: 王因仁慈和誠實得以保全他的國位， 也因仁慈立穩。

en.text: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

zhSimplified.text: 强壮乃少年人的荣耀； 白发为老年人的尊荣。

zhTraditional.text: 強壯乃少年人的榮耀； 白髮為老年人的尊榮。

en.text: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

zhSimplified.text: 鞭伤除净人的罪恶； 责打能入人的心腹。

zhTraditional.text: 鞭傷除淨人的罪惡； 責打能入人的心腹。
